description.value:
Duration constant

Hazardous ground you create lasts 1 hour instead of 10 minutes, and persists through rain, wind, water and the ordinary means of putting a fire out. Only a deliberate effort to neutralise it — the right reagent, the right skill, ten uninterrupted minutes — removes it early.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
